programs: Every independently frozen main/EoH/stage3/R1 program plus both predeclared manual programs; deduplicate only exact canonical source hashes, retain every logical alias and discovery/training seed
exact_work_formula: 200*n*(n-3)/2 unordered valid 2-opt deltas; NN zero and pure2opt may terminate early
timing_instances: all1194, all5 seeds, every unique frozen arithmetic program and traditional/neural-direct baseline
time_contract: A single nested5s trajectory yields conservative last-completed-operation1s/5s snapshots; initialization, features and neural inference included. Atomically late improvements excluded; actual wall and atomic overrun reported. Not a hard process-stop SLA.
schedule: serial solver tasks on one pinned available CPU, no training/discovery or other benchmark jobs; deterministic shuffled instance order and per-chunk rotated method order. Shared cloud host interference cannot be ruled out.
neural_direct_teacher: unchanged stage2 Transformer101/202/303 equal FP32 mean, threshold>max(.001,std), standard GLS fallback; no final tuning
external_protocol: Unchanged pinned author weights/search and LKH3.0.6 RUNS1/MAX_TRIALS1000; own measured costs, not identical internal work or strict1/5s budgets
references: Joshi author tour recomputed float64; INViT author Gurobi tour recomputed float64 with stored scalar cross-check; TSPLIB official best-known integer length. Gap-to-reference is not a certification of continuous optimality.
lkh_integer_guard: Require max(input_integer)*100 < 2**31-1 before subprocess; never silently change scale or parameters after final outcomes
uncertainty: Mean5 solver seeds per original instance first; retain all discovery/training seeds, no winner selection. Report5000 original-instance paired bootstrap intervals conditional on frozen programs and discovery-seed effects separately. Source/size groups separated; TSPLIB size bands50-100/101-200/201-500 and instance table.
primary_contrast: grpo-state/B minus grpo-terminal/A mean gap percentage points; lower is better
secondary_contrasts: terminal GRPO A minus SFT A
state GRPO A minus terminal GRPO A
state GRPO B minus terminal GRPO B
failure_policy: Retain every failure and consumed cost; predeclared fallback NN with failed flag for a solver runtime failure, no best-of retry. Infrastructure recovery resumes completed immutable chunks and logs lost attempts; any repair must preserve methods and never tune from final outcomes.
